summary_en: On November 9, 2026, the board authorized an immediate block trade on ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 1,007 yen to acquire up to 300,000 shares (1.0% of outstanding shares) for up to 302.1 million yen, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the board of directors of Cota Co., Ltd. authorized an immediate self-share acquisition through an off-hours block trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company will place an order on ToSTNeT-3 at 8:45 a.m. on November 10, 2026, to acquire up to 300,000 shares at the closing price of 1,007 yen on November 9, 2026, for a total amount not to exceed 302.1 million yen. This represents 1.0% of the 29,123,741 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026.

The acquisition is for the purpose of enhancing shareholder returns and enabling flexible capital policies to improve capital efficiency. The purchase order will be limited to the ToSTNeT-3 trading session on that date, with no changes to other trading systems or trading hours. The company will announce the acquisition results after the trading session concludes. The share count will not be adjusted, though there is a possibility that the full amount or part of the acquisition may not be executed due to market conditions.
